content.short: Paxos is a regulated financial institution providing tokenized RWAs including USDP and the gold-backed PAXG.
content.description: Paxos is a leading regulated blockchain infrastructure platform and financial institution, dedicated to bridging the gap between traditional finance and the decentralized economy. The platform specializes in the tokenization, custody, and settlement of high-quality real-world assets (RWAs). Paxos is the official issuer of prominent digital assets like USDP (Pax Dollar), a regulated USD-backed stablecoin, and PAXG (Pax Gold), where each token is backed by physical gold. Subject to NYDFS oversight, Paxos provides institutional-grade security and transparency for all participants.
